review_method.scope: Independent review of the 18 assigned Scribe Settings reference cases only.
review_method.text_reads: Each assigned case JSON, standalone state, capture metadata, replay actions and stdout log was read statically. Relevant frozen scope/plan sections and targeted frozen HANDOFF/prototype declarations were also read.
review_method.original_image_viewing: All 18 assigned candidate original PNG paths and all 18 corresponding original reference PNG paths were actually opened with tools.view_image. No contact sheet, prior pixel verdict or mechanical pass substituted for original viewing.
review_method.scale: Native candidate size is 930x1240. Each reference source is 1860x2480, representing a physical-reference factor of two. tools.view_image resized reference display to 1368x1824; the original source path and owner SHA256 remain recorded.
visual_criteria: Actual selected, disabled, unavailable and error presentation
review_method.local_execution: No local or remote app, test, build, runtime probe, verification suite or replay was executed. No SSH command was used.
review_method.image_mutation: No local crop, resize, copy, compositing, repainting, image processing or image comparison program was used.
review_method.hash_method: No local hashing or automated identity validation was performed. All SHA256 values come from the assigned owner-frozen inventory, or the declared frozen reference-scope source explicitly identified in a suggestion.
review_method.exclusions: No production, harness or plan file was edited. This reviewer writes only the assigned output report.
